title: Standard Chrome Window T2 HowTo
desc: T2 domain tier. How-to: GetWindowForTarget, SetWindowBoundsAsync, multi-tab, non-active tab, minimized Chrome, coordinate clamping.
steps: GetWindowForTarget: cdp.GetWindowForTargetAsync(cdp.TargetId) returns {windowId, bounds}. Use windowId for all setBounds calls. Multi-tab: any targetId returns the ROOT browser window (all tabs share it).
Non-active tab: our CDP target may be in background. GetWindowForTarget with background tab targetId still returns correct root window. Tab does not need to be active.
Minimized Chrome: SetWindowBoundsAsync -- (1) setBounds windowState=normal (2) await WaitForWindowStateAsync(normal) (3) setBounds with actual target coords. Implemented in CdpClient.Window2.cs.

ClampBoundsToVisible: last-resort in SetWindowBoundsAsync. Calls ChromeLauncher.ClampBoundsToVisible before sending. Never use negative x as off-screen -- use MonitorFromPoint. Negative x valid on left monitor.
Chrome_WidgetWin_1 enumeration: GetWindowsByPid(chromePid).Where(w => GetClassName==Chrome_WidgetWin_1 AND GetWindow(GW_OWNER)==0 AND IsWindowVisible). First match = target for placement.
Coordinate verification: CDP:MOVE log coords should match cdp-mon ACT-POS. Discrepancy = DPI context mismatch. Check TrySetPerMonitorV2DpiAwareness called at Launcher Main() entry.
